nfl.combine_bench_press_pool_and_prior.measurement_fix: Per invitee: expected reps = Poisson/NB-GLM on 2006-2025 nflverse combine bench results with covariates position group, weight, height, and arm length (NFL.com weigh-in, missing arm length imputed from height by position); if a pro-day bench count exists, combine it as a precision-weighted average with the GLM mean (pro-day weight 0.5 of one Combine lift, flagged). Participation from nfl.combine_drill_participation_hazard refit for bench. Simulate the field maximum over participants, calibrate the yearly maximum to nfl.combine_drill_extreme_history, output P(max>=k), P(named prospect most), ties separate. As-of: day before bench testing, using only weigh-in data.

nfl.combine_vertical_jump_prior.assessment: Usable but weak. nflverse combine has vertical and broad_jump (probe REACHABLE). nfl.combo_shared_weather_leg_coupling.assessment: Recipe is detailed and point-in-time disciplined (forecast vintage for live, observed weather flagged for the fit). Weakness: the forecast-error SD by lead time needs a forecast archive; Open-Meteo past-model-runs (probe openmeteo_histfc REACHABLE) has limited depth, nowhere near 2010-2025, and NWS (probe nws_forecast POLICY_DENIED, live only). The historical fit therefore uses observed weather (look-ahead in spirit; flagged) and under-states forecast noise. Overlaps in part with nfl.weather_total_response (the mean shift), but the coupling/correlation by bin is distinct. Pair types x 3 bins have thin severe-bin samples. Agent verification only.

nfl.fantasy_dst_points_chain.assessment: Checked mechanism scoring table vs measurement. Defects: (1) '+1 forced fumble' and the points-allowed definition are not confirmed as Sleeper defaults (only the Kalshi rules text, not probed, is cited); (2) points allowed in D/ST scoring normally excludes points scored by the own defence/ST and, on many platforms, offensive-opponent pick-six handling differs, yet the measurement takes opponent simulated points directly from nfl.team_score_pmf_own_mean while also adding defensive TDs, so event points and the PA tier are not conditioned jointly (pick-six double effect); (3) events and PA are drawn from separate models. nfl.fantasy_dst_points_chain.measurement_fix: Pin the scoring table to the contract rules text captured at quote time (store version); do not assume forced-fumble points unless stated. Per shared game draw: simulate event counts (sacks NB from nfl.defence_sack_count_decomposition, INT from nfl.int_rate, fumble recoveries, D/ST TDs from nfl.dst_td_hazard, safeties/blocks at shrunk league rates), then compute points allowed as opponent offensive points drawn conditional on the same draw, excluding points scored by this D/ST and by the opponent's defence/ST, with an explicit pick-six adjustment. Map to the tier, sum with event points, output the pmf and P(points>strike); calibrate dispersion on 2015-2025 team-games.

nfl.fantasy_kicker_points_chain.assessment: Mechanism and measurement agree and are computable: FG distance = line of scrimmage + 17 is correct, referenced ids (nfl.drives, nfl.kicker, nfl.fourth_down_fg_decision_rate) exist, pbp fields kick_distance, field_goal_result, extra_point_result are in the probed pbp. Weaknesses: the 50-59/60+ tier split (+5/+6) and the miss penalty are asserted from Kalshi text that is not in the repo and Sleeper's own default groups FGs differently (verify); 60+ attempts are so rare the tier is near-irrelevant; stall-yard-line distribution from 'drive end yard line' mixes turnovers on downs and missed FGs. Point-in-time clean. Agent verification only.

nfl.player_single_quarter_stat_extreme.assessment: Data is clean: pbp qtr, passer/rusher/receiver ids, yards_gained are in probed nflverse pbp and qtr 5 exclusion is explicit. Weakness: the model is underspecified (play count 'NB by quarter index' and 'simulated score state' without parameters) and the target is an extreme tail: 150 rushing or 150 receiving yards in a single quarter has almost no historical occurrences in 2010-2025, so calibration to per-season counts of player-quarters above the rung is statistically empty; needs a tail model (e.g. GPD on per-quarter yards). Point-in-time fine. Agent verification only.
